# @ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-stages
DSH plugin that brings the tavern-cards skill workflows into the standalone `@ai4rpg/dsh-stage-switc
h` plugin. The design decision record is docs/DESIGN.md.
English | 中文
> Note: this plugin and its stage-switch base are published under `@ai4rpg/*`. The tavern content (t
he agent preset, skills, and personas) ships in a separate GitHub repo, the tavern content repo, out
side npm. The `@deepseek-ai/*` packages appearing in this repo are upstream DSH dependencies (`dsh-a
gent`, `dsh-fs`, `dsh-session`, etc.), separate from this plugin's namespace.
It covers the three tavern-cards workflows:

- `tavern-design`: narrative/design-spec stage
- `tavern-cards`: planning, creation, MVU/EJS/configu

re, opening messages
- `tavern-ui`: status bar / frontend UI work
## What ships here, and what ships separately
This package is the **plugin**: the stage config for `dsh-stage-switch`, the project-workspace tooli
ng (`tavern_forge`, focus tracking, the completion predicate), and the persona loader the preset gen
erator uses to build its delegation rows and child presets.
The **agent preset** (`tavern-standard`), the three tavern skill bodies, the main preset's persona t
ext, and the four agent personas ship in the companion **tavern content repo** (github.com/ai4rpg/ta
vern-content; clone it to install). It holds the `@ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-preset` preset package beside t
he `@ai4rpg/tavern-agents` persona package. The preset declares `tavern-standard` and composes this
plugin's exports into it; its own READMEs and install guide carry the deployment detail.
## What it provides

- Provides `tavernCardsStageConfig` / `createTavernCardsStageConfig()` for `dsh-stage-switch`.
- Reg

isters one composite eligibility predicate reporting whether the **current** stage is complete.
- Ju
dges completion for the **focused project** (the focus tracker follows recent `fs/observed` writes),
with per-stage content checks; `content`/`ui` additionally require a successful `pack` (the pack ga

te).
- Reads `.cardrc.json`, `design-spec.md`, `创作规划.yaml`, and `tavern-cards-state.json`.
- Exposes
the forge CLI to the model as one `tavern_forge` tool (pack = `command: 'pack'`) and to humans as `

/tavern-forge` + `/tavern-pack`; `@ai4rpg/tavern-cards-forge` stays an external npm dependency.
- Ex
ports `loadTavernAgents()` (and `TavernAgentDescriptor`) so the preset package's generator can decla
re, for every agent in the `@ai4rpg/tavern-agents` content package, one delegation row (`provider: s
pawn`, `agentPreset: tavern-child-<name>`) and one child preset, from a single source — the rows, th

e presets, and the persona content cannot drift.
- Leaves skill registration to the preset package:
the CC BY-NC-SA skill bodies ship there, exposed through the official `skill-filesystem` row.

## Installation
Tavern context is **per-session**: it loads only in sessions started on the tavern agent preset. Ses
sions on any other preset get no `route` instruction, no `goto_stage`/`tavern_forge` tools, and no t
avern skills. Preset selection comes with DSH's web UI.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This plugin ships on npm; the preset package installs from the cloned content repo by absolute path
(`dsh plugin` accepts absolute specs only). The profile pulls this plugin from npm as the preset's d
in` accepts absolute specs only). The profile pulls this plugin from npm as the preset's dependency.
Requires dsh `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer on the 0.2 line: the package declares `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2
<0.3.0-0"`, which dsh's plugin manager checks before loading it.
> **Preset compatibility:** in preset deployments, this release requires the 0.2.0 preset package. T
he 0.1.0 preset still declares the retired `tavern:*` providers and `subagents.enabled`; it is not c
ompatible with this plugin. Update or regenerate the preset before switching.
Preset selection, defaults, verification, and the snapshot semantics of an edited preset are deploym
ent concerns of the content repo; its `tavern-preset/docs/install-guide.md` covers them.
## Configuration
Embed programmatically as shown in Usage. In preset deployments, parameters (the stage-switch `langu
age`, the per-tool `agentOptions`) are set on the preset's own rows; see the preset package's README
(`tavern-preset/README.md`).
## Forge CLI access
The forge CLI arrives as the external `@ai4rpg/tavern-cards-forge` dependency (published on npm; its
bin ships via `dist/index.mjs`), resolved by pnpm/npm through `node_modules`.
When `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands` is composed, the plugin registers:
- `/tavern-forge <command> [args]`: run any forge command (`init`, `configure`, `query`, `patch`, `p

ack`, ...)
- `/tavern-pack <project>`: convenience wrapper for `tavern-cards-forge pack`
Examples:

This keeps packaging available in every stage.
## Named subagents
The four agent personas (`check-agent`, `conversion-agent`, `schema-agent`, `first-message-agent`) l
ive in the `@ai4rpg/tavern-agents` content repo package (CC BY-NC-SA, licensed separately from this
MIT package). This plugin registers no delegation provider and mounts no delegation tool. `loadTaver
nAgents()` reads every persona (name, frontmatter description, body), and the preset package's gener
ator turns that list into:
- one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent` row per agent, bound to dsh's official `spawn` provider (`pro

vider: spawn`) with `agentPreset: tavern-child-<name>`, and
- one child agent preset per agent (`tav
ern-child-<name>`) whose `persona` prefix is the persona body and whose tool set is declared for tha
t agent's task (the check preset is read-only; only the conversion preset carries `bash`).
[该节后续省略]
### Per-tool models & reasoning effort
Tool children inherit the parent session's model route and, when the route is unchanged, its connect
ion-level reasoning effort; the shipped rows leave `agentOptions` unset because models differ in the
effort values they accept. Route, effort, and `maxTokens` are native fields on each `tool-subagent-
*` row's `agentOptions`; the content repo's `tavern-preset/README.md` shows how to pin them per tool
` row's `agentOptions`; the content repo's `tavern-preset/README.md` shows how to pin them per tool.
